test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
(1) The countdown ended.
(2) The rocket launched.
(3) It soared into the sky.
(4) Everyone watched in silence.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__ 
 
• The sentences describe a sequence of events related to a rocket launch. 
 
• **Sentence 1:** "The countdown ended" logically begins the sequence as it sets the stage for the launch.
 
• **Sentence 2:** "The rocket launched" follows the countdown, marking the next event in the series.
 
• **Sentence 3:** "It soared into the sky" comes after the rocket launch, describing its ascent.
 
• **Sentence 4:** "Everyone watched in silence" concludes the sequence, illustrating the reactions of the spectators.
 
• The logical order of these sentences is **1-2-3-4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arranging sentences in a logical order is key to ensuring coherence and clarity in a passage.
 
• Each sentence should build upon the previous one to create a natural flow of ideas or events.
 
• In the case of sequences describing actions or events, chronological order is often the most appropriate structure.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:**

"The countdown ended. The rocket launched. It soared into the sky. Everyone watched in silence."</div
